# SEPSIS WITH SUSPECTED MENINGITIS OR OTHER CNS INFECTION

Consider consulting Infectious Diseases if CNS infection is not strongly suspected as the main source of infection.

Empirical regimens listed below have broad coverage of likely pathogens based on infectious site. Resistant gram-negative rods and MRSA coverage is not necessary in most patients except those with recent isolates of these organisms. Strongly consider rapid de-escalation of therapy in the first 24-48 hours based on MRSA nares, isolated pathogen(s), and patient response to therapy. Refer to pathogen specific sections of the Antimicrobial CDSS for additional treatment recommendations.

---

References:

- Evans et al., Crit Care Med, 2021, 49(11):e1063-e1143.
- Mandell Chapter: Sepsis, Severe Sepsis and Septic Shock
- Rhee et al., Clinical Infectious Diseases, 2021, 72(4):541-552. PMID: 32374861
- Rhodes et al., Crit Care Med, 2022, 50(4):e413-e414. PMID: 34643578
- Sanford keyword: Sepsis, Adult
- Singer et al., JAMA, 2016, 315(8):801-810
- Up-to-date article: Sepsis syndromes in adults: Epidemiology, definitions, clinical presentation, diagnosis, and prognosis
ERUC: ORZID GMENU ER/UC SEPSIS SUSPECTED MENINGITIS
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Listeria is NOT suspected

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h](orz-set-abx-sepsis-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

### Listeria IS a concern (Adults >= 50 Years or With Alcoholism, Debilitating Disease, or Impaired Cellular Immunity)

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h <AND> ampicillin 2 gm](orz-set-abx-sepsis-ceftriax-2gm-vanco-15mg-kg-ampicillin-2gm-iv)
IV q4h

### Ceftriaxone or penicillin allergy (see below for severe reactions)

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h](orz-set-abx-sepsis-mero-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)

### Severe Beta-lactam reaction

[Moxifloxacin 400 mg IV q24h <AND> trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 5mg/kg \(TMP](orz-set-abx-sepsis-moxi-400mg-iv-tmp-smx-5mg-kg-iv-vanco)
component) IV Q6H <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h

## ER/UC

### Listeria is NOT suspected

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV once STAT](orz-set-abx-ceftr-2gm-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-once-stat)

### Listeria IS a concern (Adults >= 50 Years or With Alcoholism, Debilitating Disease, or Impaired Cellular Immunity)

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV once STAT  <AND>](orz-set-abx-ampicillin-2gm-ceftr-2gm-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-once-stat)
ampicillin 2 gm IV once STAT

### Ceftriaxone or penicillin allergy (see below for severe reactions)

[Meropenem 2 gm IV once STAT <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV once STAT](orz-set-abx-meropenem-2gm-iv-once-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-once-stat)

### Severe Beta-lactam reaction

[Moxifloxacin 400 mg IV once STAT <AND> trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole](orz-set-abx-moxi-400mg-iv-tmp-smx-5mg-kg-iv-vanco-iv-once-stat)
5mg/kg (TMP component) IV once STAT <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV once STAT
